current_ratio.interpretation: Ability to pay short-term obligations. Higher is better. Benchmark: >1.0

quick_ratio.formula: (Cash + Marketable securities + Receivables) / Current liabilities OR (Current assets - Inventory - Prepaid) / Current liabilities
quick_ratio.interpretation: Ability to pay with most liquid assets. Higher is better. Benchmark: >1.0

working_capital.interpretation: Dollar amount of net current assets. Positive is better.

receivables_turnover.formula: Net credit sales / Average accounts receivable
receivables_turnover.interpretation: How many times receivables collected. Higher is better (faster collection).

days_sales_in_receivables.formula: 365 / Receivables turnover OR (Average AR / Net credit sales) × 365
days_sales_in_receivables.interpretation: Average days to collect. Lower is better.

inventory_turnover.formula: Cost of goods sold / Average inventory
inventory_turnover.interpretation: How many times inventory sold. Higher is better (less obsolescence risk).

days_inventory_on_hand.interpretation: Average days inventory held. Lower is better.

asset_turnover.interpretation: Efficiency of asset use. Higher is better.

gross_profit_margin.formula: (Sales - COGS) / Sales OR Gross profit / Sales
gross_profit_margin.interpretation: Profit before operating expenses. Higher is better.

operating_profit_margin.interpretation: Profit from operations. Higher is better.

net_profit_margin.interpretation: Bottom line profitability. Higher is better.

return_on_assets.interpretation: Profit generated per dollar of assets. Higher is better.

return_on_equity.interpretation: Return to shareholders. Higher is better.

debt_to_equity.interpretation: Financial leverage. Lower is less risky.

debt_to_assets.interpretation: Portion of assets financed by debt. Lower is less risky.

equity_multiplier.interpretation: Leverage (higher = more debt). Used in DuPont analysis.

times_interest_earned.interpretation: Ability to cover interest. Higher is better. Benchmark: >2.0

price_to_earnings.formula: Market price per share / Earnings per share
price_to_earnings.interpretation: Valuation multiple. Higher may indicate growth expectations.

dividend_yield.formula: Annual dividends per share / Market price per share
dividend_yield.interpretation: Cash return to investors. Higher may attract income investors.

payout_ratio.formula: Dividends per share / Earnings per share OR Total dividends / Net income
payout_ratio.interpretation: Portion of earnings paid as dividends. Higher leaves less for reinvestment.

dupont_analysis.formula: ROE = Net profit margin × Asset turnover × Equity multiplier
dupont_analysis.interpretation: Decomposes ROE into profitability, efficiency, and leverage

cpa_exam_tips: Current ratio = CA / CL. Quick ratio excludes inventory.
Turnover ratios: Higher is better (faster activity). Days ratios: Lower is better.
ROA = NI / Assets. ROE = NI / Equity. ROE usually higher than ROA (leverage).
Times interest earned = EBIT / Interest (measures coverage).
Gross margin = (Sales - COGS) / Sales. Net margin = NI / Sales.

key_points: DuPont: ROE = Net margin × Asset turnover × Equity multiplier
